verdict.rationale: Ubuntu Desktop's own documentation lists the AT-SPI D-Bus XML interfaces (org.a11y.atspi.Accessible, org.a11y.atspi.Action), a documented public programmatic interface for inspecting and acting on desktop UI elements. That gives automation clients, including AI agents, a real way to drive the desktop. The evidence is only a single index-level mention framed around accessibility, not a general automation or control API. missing for 10: a documented general-purpose automation/control API beyond accessibility, depth of API reference and usage guidance, any hands-on or independent corroboration of agents driving the desktop this way.
